ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous fields across both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation is localized to a continuous border along the trailing edge and concentrated clusters at the distal tips. A single distinct low-intensity focal spot is visible on the medial-lower region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and a depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks and valleys) are visible along the entire boundary, with increased complexity on the distal thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature following the trailing edge from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in rounded, convex outer points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, low-intensity pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle-induced scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and significant tissue loss along the outer trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating physical trauma or advanced weathering.
other_distinctive_markers: One isolated, circular low-intensity marker (focal spot) located in the lower-central quadrant of the left lobe.
